**Feature Description**
A clear description of the new visual feature or animation effect.

**Visual Reference / Moodboard**
Links, timestamps, or descriptions of music videos / motion graphics with this style.

**Implementation Concept**
How this could be implemented in GSAP or Hyperframes (e.g. blend modes, transforms).
